kurals.tr: Ullak Kaliththalum Kaana Makizhdhalum / Kallukkil Kaamaththir Kuntu
kurals.m: To please by thought and cheer by sight is peculiar, not to liquor but lust

kurals.tr: Thinaiththunaiyum Ootaamai Ventum Panaith / Thunaiyum Kaamam Niraiya Varin
kurals.m: If women have a lust that exceeds even the measure of the palmyra fruit, they will not desire (to feign) dislike even as much as the millet

kurals.tr: Penaadhu Petpave Seyyinum Konkanaik / Kaanaa Thamaiyala Kan
kurals.m: Though my eyes disregard me and do what is pleasing to my husband, still will they not be satisfied unless they see him

kurals.tr: Ootarkan Sendrenman Thozhi Adhumarandhu / Kootarkan Sendradhu En Nenju
kurals.m: My heart, forgetting all, could not its love restrain

kurals.tr: Ezhudhungaal Kolkaanaak Kannepol Konkan / Pazhikaanen Kanta Itaththu
kurals.m: Like the eyes which see not the pencil that paints it, I cannot see my husband's fault (just) when I meet him

kurals.tr: Kaanungaal Kaanen Thavaraaya Kaanaakkaal / Kaanen Thavaral Lavai
kurals.m: When I see my husband, I do not see any faults; but when I do not see him, I do not see anything but faults

kurals.tr: Uyththal Arindhu Punalpaai Pavarepol / Poiththal Arindhen Pulandhu
kurals.m: Like those who leap into a stream which they know will carry them off, why should a wife feign dislike which she knows cannot hold out long?

kurals.tr: Iliththakka Innaa Seyinum Kaliththaarkkuk / Kallatre Kalvanin Maarpu
kurals.m: O you rogue! your breast is to me what liquor is to those who rejoice in it, though it only gives them an unpleasant disgrace

kurals.tr: Malarinum Mellidhu Kaamam Silaradhan / Sevvi Thalaippatu Vaar
kurals.m: Sexual delight is more delicate than a flower, and few are those who understand its real nature

kurals.tr: Kannin Thuniththe Kalanginaal Pulludhal / Enninum Thaanvidhup Putru
kurals.m: She once feigned dislike in her eyes, but the warmth of her embrace exceeded my own
